examples: I call my friend every day.
Is it OK to sit here?

meaning_hint: In modern Ukrainian гей usually means 'gay'; for 'hey' people often say ей.

examples: The shop has a lot of people.
Five people live in my house.
note: People is plural: "people are", not "people is". One person, two people.

meaning_hint: Only as an English title or form of address (сер Пол Маккартні); the polite Ukrainian address is пане.
note: A polite word for a man. For a woman, say "ma'am".

examples: My father has a small business.

meaning_hint: Slang; the standard word is вибачте / пробач.
examples: Sorry, can you say that again?
I'm so sorry about your dog.

meaning_hint: Only the noun (a show); 'to show' is показувати.
examples: We watch a show every night.
Do you have a chance to call?
I am busy at the moment.
Can you help me for a moment?

meaning_hint: Ukrainian бебі is mostly used in compounds (бебі-бум, бебі-сітер); the usual word is немовля.
examples: Her baby is one year old.
The city has a million people.
This house costs two million dollars.
Millions of people use this app.
note: Say "two million dollars", not "two millions dollars".

meaning_hint: An office (workplace); a public office/post is посада.
examples: My office is on the second floor.

meaning_hint: For a medical doctor Ukrainians usually say лікар; доктор is also the academic title.

examples: Hello, can I speak to Anna, please?
Say hello to your mother for me.

meaning_hint: A university or college student; a school pupil is учень.

examples: What are your plans for today?
I watch a video on my phone.

meaning_hint: Mainly a military officer; a police officer is поліцейський; офіцер is also the bishop in chess.

examples: We go to a party tonight.

meaning_hint: A refined or titled woman (перша леді = first lady); an ordinary woman is жінка or пані.
examples: Ask the lady at the front desk.
An old lady sat next to me.
The lady in the red dress is my aunt.
note: A polite word for a woman. "Woman" is more common in everyday talk.

examples: Wow, your new car is great!
Wow, that was a fast answer.
Wow, look at all this snow!
Wow, you cooked dinner for us?

meaning_hint: Start of a race, a launch or a beginning; the usual word for 'beginning' is початок.
examples: The runners are at the start.

meaning_hint: A financial bank; a river bank is берег.
examples: My money is in the bank.

meaning_hint: Usually a vocational college (between school and university).
examples: The college is near my home.
note: In the US, "college" often means university.

meaning_hint: A movie; a thin layer or camera film is плівка.
note: In American English, "movie" is more common.

examples: Ah, that's why you were late.
Ah, this coffee is so good.

meaning_hint: Only the noun; the adjective secret is секретний.
examples: Don't tell anyone, it's a secret.
What is the secret of your good cake?
She told me a big secret.

meaning_hint: фото is indeclinable: the same form for singular and plural.
examples: Can you take a photo of us?
This is a photo of my family.
note: Say "take a photo", not "make a photo".

meaning_hint: A club (association, nightclub); a heavy stick is кийок, a golf club is ключка.
examples: I go to a sports club.

meaning_hint: Only sexual activity; sex as male/female is стать.
examples: Write your sex on the form.
note: On forms, "sex" means male or female.

meaning_hint: Also a school principal; a film director is режисер.
examples: The director is in his office.
Our hotel is near the beach.
We stayed at a small hotel.
How much is a room at this hotel?
I asked my boss for a day off.
The boss is in a meeting now.
She is the boss of a small company.

meaning_hint: Informal or in compounds (арт-простір); the usual word for art is мистецтво.
note: Art is uncountable here: "I like art", not "an art".

meaning_hint: Also checking/inspection (e.g. ticket control).
examples: The remote control is on the table.
The car is out of control.
I sent you a message this morning.
Please leave a message after the beep.
I have three new messages on my phone.

meaning_hint: Also means a prison cell or a chamber; a photo camera is also фотоапарат.
examples: My phone has a very good camera.
I forgot my camera at home.
There is a camera at the front door.

meaning_hint: Customer service, service industry; military or church service is служба.

examples: Our travel agent booked the hotel for us.
Call the real estate agent about the apartment.
The agent at the airport checked my ticket.
She works as an insurance agent.

meaning_hint: Also a school grade (year); informal клас! = cool!

examples: I listen to the radio in the car.
Can you turn on the radio?
I heard the song on the radio.
The park is near my house.

meaning_hint: Only a fan (supporter), also фанат; an electric fan is вентилятор.
examples: Are you a fan of this team?
Can I pay in dollars here?
I found a dollar on the street.
The ticket is five dollars for kids.

meaning_hint: Older spelling: проект.
Га? = Huh? What? (asking again or surprised)
Also a court trial (судовий процес).
A computer file (also a plastic sleeve for papers); a paper file/folder is папка, the tool is напилок.
examples: Please save the file before you close it.
Can you send me the file by email?
The file is on my desktop.

meaning_hint: Only the title Miss (Міс Україна = Miss Ukraine); 'to miss' is пропустити or сумувати.
examples: Miss Brown is our English teacher.
Excuse me, Miss, you dropped your bag.
Miss Lee will see you now.
note: Used before a young or unmarried woman's last name. "Ms." is safe for any woman.

meaning_hint: Mainly the command 'Stop!'; 'to stop' is зупинятися.
examples: Stop, that's enough cake for you.
The medicine has a good effect.
Coffee has a strong effect on me.
note: Effect is a noun. The verb is "affect".

examples: My professor gave us a lot of homework.
Our history professor is very funny.
Can I talk to the professor after class?
She is a professor at the university.
